hooks.name: Data Protection Check
hooks.description: Checks content before it is written to disk against .kiro/steering/data-protection.md

action.prompt: Before this write, check the content against .kiro/steering/data-protection.md. If it contains a secret (password, API key, token, private key), personal data (the name, email, phone or address of a real person), an AWS account ID, an IAM user name, a local path or machine name, or an employer-internal name, replace it with an allowed value or placeholder (user@example.com, <ACCOUNT_ID>, <TOKEN>) before writing, or stop and ask the user. Never repeat the protected value in your reply.
